# Alcoa Aluminium Scaffolding

> Scaffolding rental and sales company in Musaffah 37, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Legal name: ALCOA ALUMINIUM SCAFFOLDING - L.L.C - S.P.C. ISO 9001:2015 certified. Serves Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Musaffah, Sharjah and UAE emirates with aluminium towers, cuplock, ladders, erection and inspection services.

## Contact

- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–6pm
- Website: https://alcoascaffolding.com
